API ReferenceZscaler Internet Access APIData Loss PreventionDLP Notification Template Resource Addtemplate
DLP Notification Template Resource Addtemplate
POST
https://api.zsapi.net/zia/api/v1/dlpNotificationTemplates

Adds a new DLP notification template. To learn more, see Configuring DLP Notification Templates.

Responses
​
200

Successful Operation

APPLICATION/JSON
Schema
Example (auto)
SCHEMA
id
int32

The unique identifier for a DLP notification template.

name
string
REQUIRED

The DLP notification template name.

subject
string
REQUIRED

The Subject line that is displayed within the DLP notification email.

attachContent
boolean

If set to true, the content that is violation is attached to the DLP notification email.

plainTextMessage
string
REQUIRED

The template for the plain text UTF-8 message body that must be displayed in the DLP notification email.

htmlMessage
string
REQUIRED

The template for the HTML message body that must be displayed in the DLP notification email.
